title: Grand Theft Auto VI
content:
Grand Theft Auto VIis an upcomingaction-adventure gamedeveloped and published byRockstar Games. It is due to be the eighth main entry in theGrand Theft Autoseries, following 2013'sGrand Theft Auto V, and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictionalUS stateof Leonida, based onFlorida, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos (Manni L. Perez). Players will be able tofreely roamLeonida'sopen world, which features theMiami-inspiredVice City.

Preliminary work on the title began in 2014 following its predecessor's release, with principal production starting after the launch ofRed Dead Redemption 2in 2018. Rockstar's global development teams more than doubled sinceRed Dead Redemption2. Miami and its surrounding areas were extensively researched for the game's world, which parodies 2020sAmerican culture. The protagonists' dynamic is inspired byBonnie and Clyde, and thenon-player characters(NPCs) were written to ensure players experience different areas of Vice City.

Following years of speculation and anticipation, Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development. That September, footage from unfinished versions wasleaked.Grand Theft Auto VIwas formally revealed in December 2023. Following two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it is scheduled to be released on 19November 2026 for thePlayStation 5andXbox Series X/S. The game will also be playable onXbox OneviaXbox Cloud Gaming. It became the most pre-ordered video game of all time, with nearly selling an estimated 16 million units, and generating over $1.5 billion in worldwide revenue.

Grand Theft Auto VIis asingle-player,action-adventure gameset within anopen worldplayed from athird-personview as either Jason Duval or Lucia Caminos. Players can choose to fightnon-player characters(NPCs), steal vehicles, rob establishments or get into high-speed chases with the police.[1][2][3]When roaming freely, players have several options for activities such as skydiving, wrestling, basketball, exercising, kayaking and scuba diving.[4][5][6][7]

Throughout the game, players will be able to gain or lose weight as both Jason and Lucia, and if the player stays awake as either character for days on end, it will become visible on their faces.[8]The game will have a "Criminal Profile" rating system that tracks eachplayer character's reputation based on their actions, similar to the honour system previously used inRed Dead Redemption 2.[9]Rockstar has stated this system is not meant to portray Lucia and Jason as "do-gooders", but will track whether each character keeps their crimes professional or commits unnecessary violence with in-game consequences that reflect their reputation.[10]

In free roam, as Jason or Lucia, players can choose to split the two up to go and do their own activities independently or stay, hang out and do activities together.[11]Their relationship will depend on the player's actions[12]and, according to Rockstar, will be optional.[13]Grand Theft Auto VIwill feature a fully integrated social media app called Snapmatic, returning fromGrand Theft Auto V.[14][15]The app is meant to parody 2020s social media trends and apps such asTikTokandInstagram.[16]Players will have the option to customise the appearance of Jason and Lucia, such as changing their hair, clothes and accessories.[16][17]

Grand Theft Auto VIis set within the fictionalUS stateof Leonida, based onFlorida; its map is reported to be three times larger than the playable area ofRed Dead Redemption 2.[19]The map includesVice City,[a]Grassrivers, and the Leonida Keys (inspired byMiami, theEverglades, and theFlorida Keys, respectively). Additional locations include Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park, and Port Gellhorn.[18]The game world parodies 2020sAmerican culture, with satirical depictions ofsocial mediaandinfluencerculture, law enforcement tactics and technology likepolice body cameras, and references toInternet memessuch asFlorida Man.[22]

The story follows a criminal couple: Jason Duval, who worked for localdrug runnersin the Leonida Keys after serving in theArmy; and Lucia Caminos (Manni L. Perez),the series' first non-optional female protagonist,[b]who was imprisoned at Leonida Penitentiary after fighting for her family fromLiberty City.[25]Following a failedbank heist, the duo encounters a state-wide conspiracy and are forced to protect each other.[26]

Other characters include: Cal Hampton, Jason's paranoid friend; Boobie Ike, who runs a business empire in Vice City; Dre'Quan Priest, owner of therecord labelOnly Raw Records with Boobie; Bae-Luxe and Roxy, a musical duo signed to Only Raw under the name Real Dimez; Raul Bautista, a seasoned bank robber; and Brian Heder (Stephen Root),[27]a long-time drug runner in the Keys and Jason's landlord.[25]

Rockstar Gamesbegan preliminary work onGrand Theft AutoVIin 2014 after its predecessor,Grand Theft Auto V, was released, with early development starting in late 2018 following the release ofRed Dead Redemption 2.[28][29]Principal production began in 2020,[30]code-namedProject Americas.[29]Pre-production onProject Americasbegan in 2015 with Rockstar initially hoping it would be co-developed alongsideRed Dead Redemption2whose development was being helmed byRockstar San Diego.[31]However, as ambition grew forRed Dead Redemption2, Rockstar pooled all of its studios together to solely focus on the title while development onGrand Theft Auto VIwas delayed.[31]Rockstar's worldwide development teams more than doubled sinceRed Dead Redemption2's release.[16]When the game released, Rockstar had 2,441 employees which grew to 4,711 across 12 offices during the development ofGrand Theft Auto VI.[31]Rockstar wanted to avoid their standardcrunchpractices that had become prevalent during production onRed Dead Redemption2,[32]offering staffpaid time offif they had worked extra hours or additional pay.[31]

Resources were reallocated fromRed Dead Onlineand plannedremasters[c]in 2022 to prioritise development.[33][34]Rumours and analysts suggested the budget surpassedUS$1–2billion, which would make it themost expensive game ever developed,[35]though the figure remains unverified.[36]Rockstar denied rumours that it cost overUS$1.5billion, though it would not disclose a specific figure.[37]Rockstar requested employees ceaseremote workand return to offices from April 2024 "for productivity and security" as the release date neared.[38]TheIndependent Workers' Union of Great Britain(IWGB) criticised Rockstar for contradicting promises to maintainflexible workingconditions; employees were concerned that effects to health and morale could prompt resignations and crunch,[39]especially as managers still maintained flexibility.[40]To maintain secrecy and operational security,Rockstar North's office inEdinburghhad to installprivacy filmon its windows to avoiddronestaking photographs through windows.[41]Other measures taken include employees' personal laptops, tablets and phones being blocked from connecting to Rockstar systems, banning external storage devices likeUSB drives, and photography at work being forbidden.[41]

Rockstar fired 34 employees[d]in October 2025, due to public discussion and distribution of confidential information.[43][44]The IWGB accused Rockstar ofunion busting, stating the employees were attempting tounionisewithlabour organisers.[44]

Rockstar presidentSam Houserwas involved inGrand Theft Auto VI's development, identifying issues and giving feedback on lighting, audio, game mechanics and tone when the game had reached development milestones.[45]

The passage of time after the release ofGrand Theft Auto V, according to Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson, meant that there was immense pressure for developers to produce a sequel which surpassed fan expectations.[16]They conceivedGrand Theft Auto VI'screative direction by examining older games for ideas they believed were incomplete due to time constraints or technological limitations.[16]One such idea was a story placing romance as a central focus of the gameplay.[16]The work for the characters concentrated on immersion and how they, and in turn the players, would interact with the game world, especially in free roam.[16]This resulted in the creation of mechanics, for example, that generate changes in the appearance of characters based on circumstance, such as eating, exercising, and evading police.[16]

Rockstar undertook extensive research of Miami and its surrounding areas with a field team.[16]Starting in 2015, they organised research trips to Miami to consult with locals to gather reference material, such as law enforcement,club promoters, ex-criminals, and gun dealers.[16][31]The material was then cross-referenced with books and news articles to "get to the heart of which characters will bring [Vice City] to life."[16]Writer Michael Wiafe said the studio's vision for Vice City was one which replicated the culture of Miami with "an open mind, a genuine appreciation and a deep curiosity".[16]Rockstar deployed two subteams for the creation of NPCs and vehicles, the former from theirLos Angelesoffice. The developers greatly expanded the population of NPCs, varying each character by appearance, movement, and expression.[16]More than 50street artistswere engaged to design murals for Vice City neighborhoods.[16]Rockstar worked with Miami-based stylist Jillian Carr from 2023 to design clothing mimicking real-life fashion trends.[16]

Grand Theft Auto VIputs increased focus on realism and immersion in its gameplay systems compared to previousGrand Theft Autotitles, incorporating gameplay elements originally developed forRed Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar sought increased realism where it can help player immersion while feeling that some forms of realism in gameplay could become inconvenient or tedious for the player.[46]At points during gameplay systems development, Rockstar had to abandon some realisticrole-playingelements such as the player needing to buy groceries and restock the fridge in Jason and Lucia's safehouse. Rockstar said the experiment was not implemented into the game as it would have "complicated the mechanics" as they sought to strike a balance between realism and ease of play.[47]

Rockstar implemented a limited weapons loadout system previously designed forRed Dead Redemption 2intoGrand Theft Auto VIfor added realism and to incentivise player decision-making on choosing loadout options. Rather than the unlimited weapon inventory system from previous series entries,Grand Theft Auto VIrestricts the player to carrying two primary firearms and two sidearms at once.[48]Weapons are stored and transported in the player's vehicle, much like weapons being stored on the player's horse inRed Dead Redemption 2.[49]However, building the loadout system into aGrand Theft Autotitle reportedly took years of development time as Rockstar struggled to decide on how they should approach its implementation.[50]Rockstar were aware that players would notice missing gaps in the weapon UI due to the limited loadout so sought to redesign the UI accordingly. They struggled with formulating a new weapons UI as they kept prototyping alternatives before ending up back at a version of the weapon wheel.[50]Like its predecessor,Grand Theft Auto VIwill not include afirst-persongameplay mode at launch, with the exception of when aiming certain weapons. Nelson explained that this was a result of prioritizing the quality of third-person animations.[51]

Grand Theft Auto VIis the first mainlineGrand Theft Autostory written without the involvement ofDan HousersinceGrand Theft Auto(1997),[52][53]as Houser left Rockstar in 2020.[54]The initial outline forGrand Theft Auto VI's narrative had taken shape by late 2019 when it was decided it would feature the criminal couple of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in a Bonnie and Clyde inspired story.[31]Grand Theft Auto VItakes inspiration fromRed Dead Redemption 2in its story being structured around distinct chapters.[55]Rockstar wanted to tell a deeper story than any previousGrand Theft Autotitle in which they want players to form a stronger connection with protagonists Jason and Lucia like they did withArthur Morgan.[56]Like with how players shaped their own Arthur Morgan inRed Dead Redemption 2through dialogue choices with NPCs, Rockstar wanted to continue their stories being character-led.[56]Jason and Lucia's safehouses across Leonida inGrand Theft Auto VIoperate likeRed Dead Redemption 2's interactable camps that provide an opportunity to build stronger character bonds.[56]In developing the relationship between Jason and Lucia and the role it plays in the narrative, writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern said the studio "wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other".[57]

Like with previous games,Grand Theft Auto VIsatirises contemporary American culture, but Rockstar avoided making crude jokes aboutmarginalised groupsin the way prior games did.[29][58]In creating a satirical version of America in the 2020s, Rupert Humphries said the world "has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face" than the real world it is based on.[57]However, they wanted to be "careful" with what they satirise for fear that it could become dated fast given the length of the game's development period. Characters are designed to "feel somewhat timeless" in not using the mostcontemporary slangor referencingmemeswith a short shelf life.[59]A writing team based in Los Angeles was assembled, which included comedy writers, that was dedicated to NPC dialogue in the open world.[60]Open world writing director James Horton argued that there are "no background" characters inGrand Theft Auto VIdepending on what the player chooses to pay attention to.[60]

Grand Theft Auto VIwas built in theRockstar Advanced Game Engine(RAGE), Rockstar's proprietary in-houseengine, forninth-generation consoles.[61]It is Rockstar's first game specifically built for ninth-generation consoles after portingGrand Theft Auto Vto the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in 2022. Rockstar similarly used the 2014 ports ofGrand Theft Auto Vto thePlayStation 4andXbox Oneas a way to become familiar with the console hardware before entering full production onRed Dead Redemption 2.[62]Grand Theft Auto VIwill also be playable on Xbox One viaXbox Cloud Gaming.[63]Development heads Phil Hooker and Aaron Garbut claimed that the technology developed forGrand Theft Auto VIwould lay the groundwork for future game development, reducing the development time between future Rockstar titles.[64]

Due to the scale of the game's world, Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson described the projections for the number of NPCs required to populate Leonida and the workload needed to realise it as "horrifying".[65]In order to help undertake such a workload, Rockstar Los Angeles was founded in 2023 as other Rockstar Games studios did not have the required production capabilities.[66]Rockstar Los Angeles were solely dedicated to NPC development with the goal of making NPCs more realistic in their appearance and behaviours.[67]NPCs are the most diverse of any Rockstar title, including physical variations in height and body size who can each have unique characteristics such as different types of freckles, moles, degrees of tanning, and tattoos.[68][69]Nelson said that "we pushed interaction with NPCs as far as we could forRed Dead Redemption 2" butGrand Theft Auto VItakes it "much further".[70]NPCs react more to player actions such as noticing the player eavesdropping on a conversation or nervously moving away upon seeing a masked Lucia drawing a gun before a store robbery.[70]Rockstar had begun working on NPC reactivity withRed Dead Redemption 2and was able to get it working on previous generation consoles due to its more sparsely populated world as opposed to a denser, modern setting.[70]Rockstar avoided the use ofprocedural generationfor creating NPCs inGrand Theft Auto VI, opting to handcraft NPCs who have their own personality traits determined by what district they are in, what they have seen, and how the player has behaved towards them.[71]The density of NPCs and simulating their associatedAIand animation in the open world heavily taxes theZen 2CPU cores in ninth-generation consoles.[72]Grand Theft Auto VIhas over 600,000 unique NPC animations, up from 300,000 inRed Dead Redemption 2and 55,000 inGrand Theft Auto V.[73]The increased variety of NPCs such as different heights created additional animation work. The animation set for a 5'6" NPC would not line up if it was to be directly mapped onto a taller 6'2" NPC. Rather than creating duplicate animation sets for NPCs of different heights, Rockstar developed a system of retargeting animations on the fly between NPCs of different proportions as a way to save on memory usage on consoles.[74]

Grand Theft Auto VI's weather system was re-engineered fromRed Dead Redemption 2in order to achieve what Owen Shepherd, Rockstar vice president of art for lighting and rendering, called a "much more localised and persistent" world that "achieve[s] a sense of scale we haven't felt before".[75]Rockstar had previously implemented avolumetricclouds and fog system inRed Dead Redemption 2whileGrand Theft Auto VIbrings more realistic cloud formations that dynamically move across the game world to emulate the variety ofweather conditions in Floridaand its tropical climate.[76]Like Florida, the state of Leonida inGrand Theft Auto VIcan receive seasonal hurricanes andtropical stormswith dynamic cloud formations allowing for localised rain showers in certain areas of the world.[77]During storms, visibility is reduced and winds become more prominent. After heavy rain spells, persistent puddles can form on the ground, rainwater can pour from rooftops and lamp posts andrainbowscan be observed under the correct lighting conditions.[78]

Grand Theft Auto VIfeatures various radio stations covering genres such aspop,country,hip-hop,African,Latin,classic rock,metal, and more. Radio stations like V-Rock, Flash FM, and Emotion 98.3 return fromGrand Theft Auto: Vice CityandGrand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories, along with '80s throwback station Vice City FM fromGrand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City.[79]Like previous entries in the series, Rockstar hired musicians to host some of the in-game radio stations inGrand Theft Auto VI, includingLana Del ReyandMorgan Wallen, who host the country station Back Country Radio, Puerto Rican singersBad BunnyandRaiNao, who host the Latin station Cocoteo FM,[80]andRobynandAlex Consani, who host the pop station Flash FM.[81]In a first for the series, players can listen to on-demandpodcastsoutside of a vehicle through their in-game smartphone.[82]

On 15 October, it was revealed that the French electronic duoJusticewould compose the game's original score.[83][84]Justice composed 3 hours of original music for the game, and have collaborated with artists such asTame Impala,SZAandGesaffelstein.[85]

Rockstar announced that the first trailer was set to premiere in December 2023 for the company's 25th anniversary.[86][e]A low-quality version wasleakedone day early on 4 December; Rockstar published the official version in response, revealing the title, protagonists, setting, release window, and consoles.[90]The trailer broke someYouTuberecords within the first day,[f]and surpassed the lifetime viewership ofGrand Theft Auto V's 2011 reveal trailer within two days, with 101million views.[96]The trailer drew several fan-created recreations,[97]and its featured song,Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road", increased in popularity.[98][g]

A second trailer was released on 6 May 2025,[26]alongside a website update with 70 screenshots and several character and location descriptions.[25][99]The trailer, recorded on the PlayStation 5,[100]featuresthe Pointer Sisters' song "Hot Together",[h]Wang Chung's "Everybody Have Fun Tonight", "Child Support" byZenglen[fr;ht], andTammy Wynette's "Talkin' to Myself Again".[102]It received a record 475million views across all platforms within 24 hours,[101][i]and won Best Game Trailer at the Golden Joystick Awards in 2025.[105]

Rockstar unveiled the cover art andspecial editionson 18 June 2026:[106]theUltimate Editiongrants additional in-game clothing, hairstyles, locations, missions, tattoos, vehicles, and weapons, while preorders receive theVintage Vice City Pack, featuring items inspired byGrand Theft Auto: Vice City(2002) and its protagonist,Tommy Vercetti.[107]Whilst this content would be locked behind the Ultimate Edition, Rockstar confirmed toKinda Funnythat there would be nomicrotransactionsin either version of the game at launch. Additionally, Rockstar also confirmed that there is nogenerative AIin the game.[108]Physical versions, containing download codes in lieu of discs to prevent leaks andreselling, are set to be available in shops on 12 November, allowing pre-loading a week before the game unlocks.[109]Players and journalists criticised content locked behind special editions[110]and the lack of discs because ofownership restrictions[111]and some retailers refused to stock the game.[112]Preorders opened on 25 June; Take-Two called sales "unprecedented and astonishing",[113][j]with most opting for theUltimate Edition.[116][k]

Preorders initiated the game's marketing campaign,[118]for which Rockstar partnered with severalsocial media platformsand companies such asNetflixandPlayStation.[119][120]Dazedran aGrand Theft AutoVIcover story for its September issue, published online on 26 August.[16]An "extended look" at the game premiered onNetflixon 27 August, several hours before its YouTube release,[121]followed by previews fromcontent creators;[122]Netflix approached Rockstar with the idea, wanting to pursue popular cultural moments, and journalists noted the partnership signalled that the game is "a major entertainment tentpole".[120]Netflix andTwitchservers experienced technical issues upon the premiere, due to a substantial viewership demand and traffic.[123][124]On 3 September, two limited edition themedDualSensecontrollers in black and white were announced with a release alongside the game.[125]On 17 September 2026, Rockstar announcedGrand Theft Auto VI: The Album, a soundtrack album for the game featuring 34 original songs.[126]The following Thursday, Rockstar announced theGrand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, a collection of accessories and merchandise related to the game, such as a map of Leonida and a crossbody bag; they note on the site that the video game is sold separately.[127][128][129]

Rockstar released a pre-launch trailer on 15 October. The song "Flower in a Hurricane" byJusticefeaturingTame Impala,SZA, andKing Gizzard & The Lizard Wizardwas used in the trailer.[83]Exclusive footage of the game showcasing Jason using dog feces as a weapon to assault an NPC was featured in an episode ofSouth Park.[130]

AsGrand Theft Auto VI's Vice City setting is a fictionalised version of Miami, Rockstar wanted to use the real city as a marketing tool for the game.Miami-Dade Countyapproached Rockstar with a pitch for the marketing campaign to take over various parts of Miami.[131]The marketing campaign was approved by the Miami-Dade County Commission in September, though some local Miami elected officials objected to the campaign such as suggesting the game promotes a culture of violence.[132]County CommissionerRené Garcíaexpressed feeling "really uncomfortable" with the city collaborating with a "game that's depicting Miami like a crime haven" or could be glorifying the city's history of crime.[133]

Starting from 1 October, the roof of theKaseya Centerwas lit up with signage reading "Welcome to Vice City" that cost $975,000.[134][135]In mid-October, wrapped cars based on the fictional vehicles of theGrand Theft Autoseries with Leonida license plates were spotted on Miami streets, a Vice Cityblimpwas seen in the skies, and Vice City-branded beach chairs and umbrellas were distributed onMiami Beach.[136]Rockstar would later recreate real footage of the wrapped cars inside the video game and  release it as "real footage" via aDade Countybranded social media account as a marketing tactic.[137][138]On November 6, MiaminightclubE11evenwas rebranded into the in-game equivalent club Nine1Nine. The opening night event featured a performance fromFlo Rida.[139][140]

Rockstar would later collaborate withNBAteamMiami HeatforA Night in Vice City, a one night event during theconcurrent NBA seasonwhere the Heat will play as "Vice City" against theMilwaukee Buckson 18 November, a day before the game's release. Additionally, marketing for the game will take over the team's uniform, stadium, and court, among others.[141][142]Miami's jerseys and game day merchandise were designed in collaboration withNikeand Travis Scott'sCactus Jack Records.[143]A special "Vice City" edition ofNBA 2K27will be released on November 27, featuring Miami Heat playerBam Adebayoon the cover.[144]

A livemusic festivalwill be hosted by Rockstar Games on November 21. The event will be held atMana WynwoodinMiami, and will feature several musicians who appear onGrand Theft Auto VI: The Album. These artists include Travis Scott, Cardi B,Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, Justice,Metro Boomin,Don Toliver,Kodak Black,Fcukers,andRauw Alejandro.[145]

Details aboutGrand Theft AutoVIemerged from insider reports several years before its announcement,[l]and the lack of official acknowledgement received media attention.[148]Rockstar confirmed development was "well underway" on 4 February 2022.[149]The game became highly anticipated,[150][m]for which it won awards atthe Game AwardsandGolden Joystick Awardsin both 2024 and 2025;[152][105]scammersused the anticipation to promotemalwareandfraudthrough false promises ofearly access.[153]A meme indicated bemusement that surprising events occurred "beforeGTA 6".[154]A phenomenon has also surfaced where workers and employees are requesting paid time off (PTO) or planning to call in sick on the day of release; aPCMagsurvey found that millions of American adults intend to take a day off for the game.[155][156][157]Some publishers rescheduled games to avoid competition;[158]Jason SchreierofBloomberg Newscalled it "a massive game of4D chessplaying out across the entirevideo game industry".[159]Industry figures hoped the game would set new pricing trends,[n]and analysts predicted record-breaking revenue.[o]The game was nearly banned inSouth Korea, as members of theGame Rating and Administration Committeeargued that the current "bodily exposure of sexual acts" found in the game "are depicted explicity or excessively so as to disrupt social order". The board reportedly felt pressure to approve the game as they did not want to be "the sole country to refuse classification to the biggest game of the year".[166][167][168]

The game is planned to be released forPlayStation 5andXbox Series X and Series Ssystems, with noWindowsrelease scheduled as of October 2026. On 10 November, Xbox has announced that the game will be playable on theXbox Oneconsole throughXbox Cloud Gaming.[169]A former Rockstar producer said the studio typically develops for consoles first rather thanpersonal computersbecause "it's always better to start with the constraints and then extend".[170]In August 2026, Rockstar confirmed the game would run at 30frames per second(FPS) on both consoles at launch, departing from the previous 60 FPS featured inGrand Theft Auto Vfor consoles.[171][172]

The firsttrailerin December 2023 revealed a 2025 release window.[90]Following March 2024 reports that the game was at risk of delay,[173]Rockstar's parent companyTake-Two Interactivesaid it remained on schedule for late 2025.[174]Employees were doubtful due to the amount of remaining work,[175]and in May 2025, the game was delayed to 26 May 2026.[176]In November 2025, Rockstar delayed the game to 19 November 2026 due to additional polishing.[177]Journalists noted the firings did not cause the delay but could impact deadlines;[178]a Rockstar North employee said morale was "at rock bottom".[179]In October 2026, industry sources reported that the game had a PC release date of Q1 2027.[180][181]

A user known as "teapotuberhacker"[p]published 90 videos to the websiteGTAForumson 18 September 2022 showing 50 minutes of work-in-progress game footage.[183]The hacker downloaded the files from Rockstar's internalSlackgroups[184]and threatened to publishsource code, assets, andinternal buildsofGrand Theft AutoVandVI.[185]Take-Two submittedtakedownsof YouTube videos andforumthreads showing the footage.[186]Journalists described the event as one of the biggest leaks invideo game history,[187]called "a nightmare for Rockstar" by Schreier[188]and "aPRdisaster" byJefferies Groupanalyst Andrew Uerkwitz.[189][190]Several developers offered sympathies[183][191]and shared work-in-progress footage of their games in solidarity.[192]Rockstar lamented the manner in which the game was first demonstrated.[193]Rockstar said in court that the incident cost the company $5million and thousands of staff hours to recover[194]and prompted increasedcybersecuritymeasures.[195]

A 17-year-old boy fromOxfordshire—identified as "teapotuberhacker" and a key member of the groupLapsus$[196]—was arrested by theCity of London Policeon 22September as part of an investigation supported by theNational Cyber Crime Unitand American federal law enforcement.[197][q]While onbailfor hackingEEandNvidiaand underpolice protectionat aTravelodgehotel, he breached Rockstar using a mobile phone, television, andFire TV Stick, and threatened to release the source code in aSlackmessage to all Rockstar staff.[196][199]Appearing before ayouth court, hepleadedguilty tobreaching bail conditionsand not guilty tocomputer misuse.[200][201]

In mid-2023, he stood trial atSouthwark Crown Courtfor twelve offences, including six counts of computer misuse, three ofblackmail, and two of fraud.[196][202]He was deemedunfit to stand trialdue to hisautism;[199]a jury determined he had committed the acts,[196][203]and a judge placed him under an indefinitehospital orderin December for being a high public risk as he was violent in custody and expressed intent to continue committingcybercrimes.[194][199]He was moved to aprisonin July 2026,[204]and pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar and other companies in November.[205]

The in-game map and several minutes of footage were leaked in August 2026 by an account known as "CyberLeek", who threatened to release more material unless plans were changed regarding special edition–only content and lack of discs.[206]Journalists compared the demands to theStop Killing Gamesmovement,[r]though some expressed concern that it was acryptocurrency scamowing to a watermark on released video promoting their "$CYBERLEEK"meme coin.[208]CyberLeekburnedcoins valued at more thanUS$1millionin response,[209]claiming to raise money for a "secret project" to fightanti-consumeristpublishing practices.[210]

Some footage suggested CyberLeek had a playable build of the game,[211]with voting via paid tokens determining which clips leaked next;[212]at least 16 videos were leaked over nine daysby 26August[update].[213]Some leaked footage raised concerns about a possible graphical downgrade from the first trailer.[214]Take-Two filedsubpoenarequests withDiscord,Microsoft, andX Corp.in theUnited States District Court for the Southern District of New York, seeking records to identify CyberLeek.[212][215]PopularGrand Theft Autostreamer DarkViperAU's Discord server was among the few that were subpoenaed.[216]

Rockstar publicly acknowledged the leaks on 26August, calling them "heartbreaking for our team", and apologised for the delays in development and marketing.[217]On 27 August, media reported that CyberLeek had withdrawn roughly $268,000 in transaction fees to four different crypto wallets hours ahead ofthe Netflix reveal, leading to a collapse in the value of the meme coin and speculation that the leaks had ended.[218]In October, Cyberleek released further material, including gameplay videos depicting Jason and Lucia exploring the open world while nude.[s]Nicole Carpenter ofAftermathnoted the NPC's lack of reaction to Jason's nudity in one of the videos, and surmised that Cyberleek was likely utilising adebug modeto create the videos rather than taking advantage of an intended feature.[221]

In January 2025, aReddituser posted a photograph and two videos of a PlayStation 5development kitrunning the game, taken atRockstar San Diegoin mid-2021.[224]After the post was deleted,Polygon's Ian Walker wrote that it revealed no new information and called it the "worst leak of all time".[225]The leaks were referenced in the opening of the second trailer in May, wherein Jason is "just fixing some leaks".[226]In November, some development footage appeared in a former Rockstar animator'sshowreel.[227]

Prior to its official release, the digital analytics platform,Sensor Towerestimated thatGrand Theft Auto VIhad sold nearly 16 million pre-order copies, generating approximately over $1.5 billion in worldwide revenue.[233][234]This made it the most pre-ordered video game of all time, surpassing the previous record of 8 million copies held byCyberpunk 2077.[234][235][236]Approximately 75% of pre-orders were made forPlayStation 5, while the remaining 25% were forXbox Series X/S.[233][234]The game had reported to have contributed to a 22% increase in PlayStation 5 console sales.[237]Take-Two Interactive's CEO,Strauss Zelnickstated that the company's pre-sales expectations for the game had been exceeded significantly.[238]
